Fastest animals, ranked: the cheetah isn't #1 🐆🦅

D: Lion, about 50 mph
C: Cheetah, 0 to 60 mph in under 3 seconds
B: Black marlin, up to 80 mph (an estimate)
A: White-throated needletail swift, 105 mph in level flight
S: Peregrine falcon, more than 185 mph in a hunting dive

Source: Britannica, "The Fastest Animals on Earth". Speeds are the figures Britannica gives; some are estimates.
